must_haves: Hands-on experience with an LLM framework
Comfortable with Git and REST APIs
nice_to_haves: Exposure to Docker and basic CI/CD

competencies.name: Python fundamentals
competencies.description: Strong understanding of data structures, object-oriented programming, and testing in Python.

competencies.name: LLM framework experience
competencies.description: Hands-on experience with frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph to build AI features.

competencies.name: RAG understanding
competencies.description: Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation techniques, including chunking strategies and embeddings.

competencies.description: Ability to explain the architecture and trade-offs of at least one completed project.
